data.title: Documented Scope vs Effective Scope

left.label: DOCUMENTED — what you wrote down
left.note: inbox + sent folder for the agent's account

right.label: EFFECTIVE — what an indirect request returns
right.note: anything quoted, linked, referenced, or leaked in a reply

data.sparkLine: Test the indirect request before you trust the scope.

data.title: Contingent vs Fundamental

left.label: CONTINGENT — engineering closes it
left.note: missing tool, rate limits, budget caps — add them, the gap goes away

right.label: FUNDAMENTAL — architecture, not effort
right.note: prompt injection, observability blindness, the autonomy–competence gap

data.sparkLine: Route the failure before you write the fix.

data.title: Validation Is Not Design
data.note: "the agent should have been built with..." is a design proposal — a different discipline
data.sparkLine: Validate the agent you have, this week.
